sections.text_helper: Section 8.6.2 "IAC interrupt status register x (IAC_ISRx)" in chapter 8 (Illegal access controller (IAC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 283.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x080 + 0x4 * x (x = 0 to 5)
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Secure privileged, read only.
[Table 30. IAC interrupt request]
Bits 31:0 IAF{i + 32 * x}: Illegal access interrupt enable for peripheral {i + 32 * x} (i = 0 to 31)
Each bit is set when an illegal access event occurs in the peripheral {i + 32 * x} (see
Section8.3 for details). This bit is cleared when the corresponding IAF bit is set in IAC_ICRx.
0: No illegal access event detected for the peripheral (since reset or the last time this bit was
cleared).
1: At least one illegal access event has been detected for the peripheral (since the last time
this bit was cleared).
